svg.title: Assever: agent governance and purchase integrity
svg.desc: Implemented local architecture retaining Assever's console, gateway, core and SDK boundaries. Extend annotations identify upgrades to existing components. New annotations identify purchase accounting and projections inside the core, a separate execution worker, and isolated evaluation infrastructure. See current release status for local verification and remaining qualification gates.
svg.text: Same product, console, gateway, core and SDK. Purchase integrity becomes an additional governed workflow.
LOCAL DOCKER · original gateway + integrated purchase profile
LOCAL DOCKER · existing service boundaries retained
Keeps Tasks, Needs you and Receipts.
Reviews one work order; sees approved
Keeps Activity, review, replay and Evaluation.
Retain Reader → Resolver team and live
Keep ADK callbacks and remote clients. A purchase
proposal returns an operation ID; callers poll
status instead of reporting payment success.
Agent key: can propose, never approve
memory and callbacks remain data. None can
Tasks: purchase detail within a work order.
Same design tokens, stamps and navigation
Retain grounded MAY / NEVER clauses and human confirmation. Add a typed purchase annex: demand
IDs, units, alternatives, suppliers, all-in cap, delivery fields and expiry.
One workflow ID · one owner · one reviewed contract version
Keep rules, local classifier, provenance/taint tracking and optional Model Armor. Purchase
content passes through the same read boundary.
Keep HMAC-sealed workflow provenance. Add recipient/audience/expiry-bound, attenuated grants;
child agents share the same root quantities and budget.
Action gate · existing deterministic enforcement point
Keep recipient, record, field and content-tracing checks. Purchase calls additionally validate
the final checkout and atomically reserve root money, quantities and purchase count before
Read/draft stay local · STOPPED: refused · WAITS: approval · ADMITTED: queued, not yet RAN
Keep owner-only exact, single-use, expiring approvals. Bind purchase exceptions to old/new scope
and checkout bytes. Narrowing or revocation changes the root epoch for future admissions.
Keep chained receipts, source-linked explanations and citation-checked reports. Link durable
operation IDs to provider observations; unknown stays unknown until supported by evidence.
RAN only after a verified effect · no agent self-attestation of payment success
Core module, stored in the existing
shared demand IDs; locked admission; disjoint
One transaction: root checks + reservation + outbox
Typed core / adapter interface. Binds final
disclosures, adapter version and exact request
An LLM proposes; deterministic code decides
Local Qwen via private Ollama. Existing Vertex
AI / ADK adapters remain optional. Model
outputs never grant authority or settle money.
adds a layer; enforcement still checks actions.
Retain work orders, approvals and receipts.
Private worker container; same public gateway.
Claims the durable outbox, uses stable
Worker reaches participating tools · private network
boundaries. Add effect joins, worker roles
Extend the existing Evaluation surface with
the shared corpus and matched controls.
Provider truth for evaluation ≠ authority for recovery
Retain email, refunds, invoices, records and
private executor path and typed consequence
No direct agent route to consequential purchase APIs
Test service only · no live DPI / money / personal data
Keep tools, contacts, records and company rules.
Add trusted catalog units, merchant/payee mapping,
allowed delivery fields and adapter capabilities.
accounting admits one approved basket, not two
Allow reviewed alternatives when stock changes. A
hidden instruction still cannot change destination,
units, supplier scope or data sharing.
A lost response does not free the budget or
trigger a blind resend. Reconcile actual
effects; retain unknown exposure for opaque
Revocation stops new admissions, not past effects
THE DEMONSTRATION · ONE EXISTING TASK, FOUR PRESSURES
Existing filter + action gate stop the off-order call and retain
New atomic root ledger stops a second basket even when the money
New worker reconciles; pending exposure remains reserved until
Agents choose a permitted alternative; receipts show what
System Resilience · Trust & Consent · Accountability · legible English/Hindi purchase fields
